Subject: Re: Bulk certificate submission — SFTP workflow?

Hi Andrew — thanks for the note and the stub. We can support a batch manifest + zipped PDFs over SFTP. High-level process and requirements below:   

1) Endpoint and account
   - sftp://sftp.redwood-inference.com/incoming/brightoak/
   - temporary user: brightoak_uploads (will expire after 14 days)

2) Accepted package format
   - One manifest CSV (UTF-8) + PDFs zipped together (example: brightoak_20270628_manifest.zip).
   - We prefer: manifest.csv + all signed PDFs in a /pdfs folder inside the zip.
   - File types: .csv, .pdf, .zip. PGP encryption is optional but recommended for PHI/PII; if you PGP the zip, please also upload the public key to the keydir (sftp://.../keys/).

3) Manifest requirements (first pass automated ingest):
   - Columns required: EIN, legal_name, ship_to_name, ship_to_address_line1, ship_to_city, ship_to_state, ship_to_zip, effective_from (YYYY-MM-DD), effective_to (YYYY-MM-DD), signer_name, signer_title, signed_date (YYYY-MM-DD), pdf_filename
   - EIN must be 9 digits (no hyphen). Dates ISO format.
   - pdf_filename must exactly match file inside the zip and be a PDF.

4) Processing & SLA
   - Ingest window: 24–48 business hours for automated validation and ingestion.
   - Invoice holds: we can release holds after successful ingest and a quick manual QA pass (usually same day as ingest completes). For enterprise accounts with POA on file we can enable auto-release on ingest success — I need to confirm with Naomi and ops (cc'ed).

5) Exceptions
   - If there are overlapping coverage dates for a single ship-to, flag rows and we'll handle on case-by-case basis.

I've attached step-by-step upload instructions (sftp_upload_instructions.pdf). Please upload a single test manifest (small sample) first — filename suggestion: brightoak_test_manifest_20270628.csv — once that passes we'll schedule the full batch.

If you want, Karthik can set up an ingestion slot.

Best,
Marcus
Manager, Revenue Operations — Billing & Tax
Redwood Inference

2) Overlapping dates: occasionally our legal team issues blanket coverage that overlaps with prior certificates. For the automated ingest, what rule should we follow (earliest effective_from? latest effective_to?).

We will PGP-encrypt the zip and upload tonight. Attaching the CSV stub again for reference. Once the test passes, we will push the full zip. —Andrew

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Hi Andrew / Marcus — quick checklist from Acceptance & Tax ops so there's no surprises when the package arrives. Please follow these exactly for automated acceptance: 

- Manifest CSV header (exact): EIN,legal_name,ship_to_name,ship_to_address_line1,ship_to_city,ship_to_state,ship_to_zip,effective_from,effective_to,signer_name,signer_title,signed_date,pdf_filename
- EIN: 9 numeric characters only (strip hyphens).
- Dates: YYYY-MM-DD (ISO); if effective_to is open-ended, use 9999-12-31.
- PDF naming: must be unique and match manifest; max 150 chars; avoid special chars.
- Each PDF must contain a visible signature and printed signer name. We will not accept scanned incomplete forms.
- Checksums: please include a SHA256 checksum for the zip as a separate .sha256 file (format: SHA256  filename.zip). Example command: sha256sum brightoak_20270628_manifest.zip > brightoak_20270628_manifest.zip.sha256
- Test file: name it brightoak_test_manifest_20270628.csv and include 5 rows (mix of single-EIN-multi-shipto and single-shipto).
- Policy on same EIN -> multiple ship-tos: Acceptable. Manifest should include one row per ship-to address. If a single signed blanket PDF covers multiple ship-tos, include the same pdf_filename on each respective row and set coverage dates identically.
- Overlapping dates: our automated logic will prefer the row with the earliest effective_from and longest effective_to when duplicates occur; flagged overlaps will surface to manual QA.
- POA: since you attached a signed POA, and if it's valid and matches the EIN/authorized signer, we can opt into auto-release on successful ingest. We will still run a brief manual QA to confirm no mismatches.

Please upload the test manifest to the SFTP path Marcus shared and post a brief note here when complete. If you have trouble with checksums or PGP, ping Karthik.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Tax Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
